blockers.description: Corporate API gateway (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://orion-model.wneweb.com.tw/anthropic/, Vertex-backed) runs at ~76 output tokens/sec. A max-effort Opus 5 request producing 32k output tokens measured 423 seconds. Two consecutive gsd-phase-researcher spawns on opus died with 'Agent terminated early due to an API error: The operation timed out' and wrote nothing to disk.
blockers.workaround: Run the planner as opus + chunked mode (workflow.plan_chunked is now true) so each agent run is short and each plan commits individually. For non-critical agents, spawn on sonnet. ALWAYS check the filesystem before treating an empty Agent return as failure — sonnet agents completed their work on disk twice while returning nothing.

decisions.decision: Run the Phase 4 planner as opus + chunked mode
decisions.rationale: Chunked mode splits one long planner run into a short outline run plus one short run per plan, committing each plan individually. On a ~76 tok/s gateway this keeps every agent run inside the timeout window and makes a crash resumable from the last committed plan, while keeping opus-level planning quality. Recorded operationally as workflow.plan_chunked=true in .planning/config.json.

decisions.decision: Ran the Phase 4 researcher and pattern-mapper on sonnet instead of the configured opus
decisions.rationale: Two opus spawns timed out with zero output. Sonnet completed both. This is a per-spawn deviation for this session only — researcher_model in config remains opus.

decisions.decision: Diagnosed the API failures as gateway throughput, not proxy misconfiguration
decisions.rationale: NO_PROXY correctly covers .wneweb.com.tw so the API host bypasses the squid proxy; connect=0.128s; SSE is passed through unbuffered (TTFB 0.32-0.43s), ruling out the common Nginx proxy_buffering fault. The gateway simply runs slowly and long agent turns exceed the client request timeout.
